to.description: The account to offer it to, by handle or DID. Absent, the offer is withdrawn.

name.description: The name it would have there: its own when absent.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The account is the owner's own, there is no such account, or the repository is private.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The account logged in is not the repository's owner.

transfer.description: Where it is offered now; absent once withdrawn.

main.description: Names, in the repository's dev.knotless.repo record, the account and name it is offered to, as `knotless repo transfer` does, or with no `to` takes the offer back. It moves when that account takes it up (dev.knotless.acceptTransfer). A private repository cannot move. Only its owner, logged in to this appview's web pages, can: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account, which the pages' session cookie names.

description: Offers a repository to another account, or withdraws the offer.
